purpose: Inventory TCGA primary-tumor and solid-tissue-normal availability in the exact frozen PanCanAtlas RNA and methylation sources before any tumor-normal biological comparison.
inventory_outputs: per-cancer complete paired patient counts with RNA+methylation tumor and normal

primary_unpaired_track.comparison: within cancer, equal-n tumor versus solid-tissue-normal using unchanged C1 constructions and construction-aware null correction

paired_patient_track.rule: same participant must contribute sample type 01 and 11 in both RNA and methylation; no cross-patient pairing

claim_logic.if_tumor_and_normal_are_comparable: retain architecture as recurrent tissue organization but do not call it tumor-specific
claim_logic.if_reproducible_tumor_normal_difference: report direction and magnitude without converting association into mechanism
